items.title: app: the composition root builds the real server engine over the stored address and the session seam
items.red_not_run: the server link tests call composition root parameters that do not exist on main (serverEngineFactory, sessionToken), so every one of them fails to compile there and no red leg is run. The mutants and the two controls carry the proof; the one existing test that changes by behaviour only, the server mode test of the dictation flow, is covered by mutants A8 and A10.
